<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M+1 peak at ~12.5 % of the monoisotopic peak and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks—the pattern matches the expected carbon 13C distribution for ~11–12 carbons, while no characteristic M+2 intensities for Cl, Br, or S are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
